built_for: #change Locate screen — current state (extent / condition / change)
licence: CC BY 4.0 upstream (GMW v4.1.12 2025 extent; Goldberg ORNL DAAC 1768 mangrove loss drivers; Dynamic World built modal). Non-commercial / research P2.
resolution_plain: Extent is GMW 2025 stock (~30 m native, ~100 m after simplify). Loss and built samples remain generalised (~100–300 m). All Locate overlays fade past about zoom 11.5 so blocky edges do not look like broken fine data beside Satellite.

state_gaps.plain: GMW 2025 mangrove extent ships as a coastal stock layer on Locate (open CC BY). Annual time slider / multi-year extent change remains a data need.
No mangrove condition, health, canopy, or degradation score ships on this console. Note 3b: degradation not mapped (no canopy layer cleared for public).
Open coastal samples only: 2000–2016 loss drivers and a built-up proxy. Not an annual change time slider or multi-epoch urban expansion series.

layers.title: Mangrove extent 2025 (stock)
layers.resolution_plain: GMW v4.1.12 2025 extent, coastal four-province clip, simplified for Locate (~100 m display). Living stock — not a condition score.
layers.note: Global Mangrove Watch annual extent 2025 (CC BY 4.0). Clipped to L20 coastal provinces; MMU 0.5 ha. Fills the Locate extent / stock facet. Not GMW change, not canopy condition.

layers.title: Mangrove loss drivers
layers.resolution_plain: Goldberg loss drivers, coastal sample, simplified for the public stub (~150 m display). Coarser than Read’s 10 m class map.
layers.note: Open coastal sample of ORNL DAAC mangrove loss drivers (2000–2016). Not GMW annual change — data need for time slider.

layers.title: Built-up / urban change
layers.resolution_plain: Dynamic World built modal, coastal sample, simplified for the public stub (~200 m display). Pressure context only.
layers.note: Open coastal sample of Dynamic World modal built (class 6). GHS-BUILT multi-epoch remains a data need.
